rules.statement: The oral and documentary evidence successfully rebutted the prima facie evidence from declarations made under Section 41 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: that the prima facie evidence of the declarations made under Section 41 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance was rebutted by the oral evidence and documentary evidence; that section 13 of Evidence Ordinance enabled Appellant to lead in evidence a document in handwriting of the Tutor admitted under section 32(7) of Evidence Ordinance to deny the right claimed by the Respondent. 274

rules.statement: The law does not permit the denial of a right claimed by a party under the Evidence Ordinance.
